 Havertz penalty shout 'clear as mud' published at 16:25 GMT 16:25 GMT 
 Arsenal 0-0 Hull City 
 Dion Dublin 
Former Coventry and Aston Villa striker on Final Score 
 It is clear as mud. You're now talking about when the ball is struck. 
 They're saying he makes the run first and he would have been offside if he hadn't have been pulled.
 Because he's been pulled, there's no offside, you're talking split seconds.

 Team news - Munoz in for Forest, Guehi starts for Man City published at 16:17 GMT 16:17 GMT Breaking 
 Nottingham Forest v Man City (17:30 BST) 
 Shamoon Hafez 
Football reporter at the City Ground 
 Image source, BBC Sport Nottingham Forest make two changes to the side beaten by Brentford last weekend.
 Daniel Munoz and Ryan Yates come into the sides, with Ola Aina and Dan Ndoye dropping out.
 Nottingham Forest XI: Sels, Munoz, Williams, Milenkovic, Murillo, Cunha, McAtee, Yates, Schlager, Gibbs-White, Delap.
 Image source, BBC Sport Manchester City boss Enzo Maresca makes three alterations to the side that beat RB Leipzig in the Champions League in midweek.
 Captain Ruben Dias, Josko Gvardiol and Jeremy Doku come in for Matheus Nunes, Nico O'Reilly and Phil Foden.
 Marc Guehi starts after being dropped for the last Premier League game.
 Man City XI: Donnarumma, Khusanov, Dias, Guehi, Gvardiol, Anderson, Fernandez, Ndiaye, Cherki, Doku, Haaland.
